ideas.title: The Impact of Fraud on Minnesota's Housing Program
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of fraud in Minnesota's Housing Stabilization Services program and its impact on residents
ideas.angle: In-depth analysis of the program's termination and its effects
questions: What was the extent of the fraud?
How will the program's termination affect residents?
searches: Minnesota Department of Human Services investigation
ideas.insight: The program's termination indicates a high level of corruption. Further investigation is needed to uncover the extent of the fraud and identify those responsible.

ideas.title: The Effectiveness of Trump's Fraud Task Force
ideas.description: Investigate the effectiveness of President Trump's task force in combating fraud in federal benefits programs
ideas.angle: In-depth analysis of the task force's efforts and areas of improvement
questions: What are the task force's goals?
How effective has the task force been?
ideas.insight: The executive order indicates a high-level effort to combat fraud in federal programs. Further investigation is needed to uncover the effectiveness of the task force and identify areas of improvement.
